components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact blue action used for the workflow's decisive next step.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--blue-dark, #0b3f6b); border-radius: 3px; color: #fff; background: var(--blue, #1769aa); cursor: pointer; font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 700; transition: transform 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--night, #0b121b); background: var(--blue-dark, #0b3f6b); } .ds-button:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(23, 105, 170, 0.32); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A low-emphasis text action that stays visually subordinate to the primary workflow.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; color: var(--muted, #5e6874); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 700; transition: transform 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-button-quiet:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: #8f8b80; } .ds-button-quiet:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(23, 105, 170, 0.32); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A bright-paper field with a fine rule and restrained square geometry.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted, #5e6874); font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 38px; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #b9bec6); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink, #111820); background: var(--paper-bright, #fffdf7); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.005em; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(23, 105, 170, 0.32); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The numbered Night-rail destination with a written label and blue active edge.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 5px; min-width: 108px; min-height: 78px; padding: 18px 14px; border: 0; color: #fff; background: var(--blue-dark, #0b3f6b); cursor: pointer; font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 720; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-item::before { position: absolute; inset: 13px auto 13px 0; width: 4px; background: #63b3ed; content: ""; } .ds-nav-index { color: #79bce9; font-size: 0.58rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--night, #0b121b); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(23, 105, 170, 0.48); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Working Text Panel
components.description: A complete ruled sheet for editable or generated working text.
components.html:
01

Original

Sample working text remains neutral and public-safe.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line, #b9bec6); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink, #111820); background: rgba(255, 253, 247, 0.92); box-shadow: 0 14px 42px rgba(11, 18, 27, 0.15); } .ds-panel-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 20px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #b9bec6); } .ds-panel-heading span { color: var(--blue, #1769aa); font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; } .ds-panel-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-family: "Iowan Old Style", Palatino, serif; font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-panel p { min-height: 92px; margin: 0; padding: 24px 28px 32px; font-family: Charter, "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.03rem; line-height: 1.7; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: A compact written state paired with a restrained blue status light.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 144px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #b9bec6); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink, #111820); background: rgba(250, 247, 239, 0.6); font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-status-pill i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--blue, #1769aa); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(23, 105, 170, 0.13); }

components.name: Outgoing Source Selector
components.description: The signature two-option selector that states which text is currently outgoing.
components.css: .ds-outgoing-selector { display: inline-flex; } .ds-outgoing-selector button { min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #b9bec6); color: var(--ink, #111820); background: var(--paper-bright, #fffdf7); cursor: pointer; font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 750; } .ds-outgoing-selector button + button { border-left: 0; } .ds-outgoing-selector button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--paper-bright, #fffdf7); border-color: var(--blue, #1769aa); background: var(--blue, #1769aa); } .ds-outgoing-selector button:hover { background: var(--blue-pale, #dbeaf6); color: var(--ink, #111820); } .ds-outgoing-selector button[aria-pressed="true"]:hover { background: var(--blue-dark, #0b3f6b); color: var(--paper-bright, #fffdf7); } .ds-outgoing-selector button:focus-visible { position: relative; outline: 3px solid rgba(23, 105, 170, 0.32); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-error-record { padding: 12px 16px; border-left: 4px solid var(--night, #0b121b); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink, #111820); background: var(--paper-bright, #fffdf7); font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-error-record p { margin: 6px 0 10px; } .ds-error-record button { min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #b9bec6); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--muted, #5e6874); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-error-record button:hover { border-color: var(--blue, #1769aa); color: var(--blue-dark, #0b3f6b); } .ds-error-record button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(23, 105, 170, 0.32); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Sayloom feels like a carefully prepared working sheet: warm paper, exact rules, ink-led typography, and a blue thread that connects source, transformation, and outgoing state. It is a quiet macOS utility rather than a generic dashboard. The interface should disappear during repeated use while remaining legible enough to trust at a glance. This is an extension of the incumbent code-defined world, not a replacement. New setup surfaces inherit the same paper, rule, rail, heading, field, and control language. Expression stays in small details—the thread mark, numbered sections, serif working text, and restrained grain—while standard controls keep their familiar behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and cool output surfaces bounded by fine, functional rules.
Near-black utility chrome with one restrained thread-blue accent.
Editorial serif for identity and working text; workhorse sans for controls.
Vertically ordered, spacious task canvases with compact operational metadata.
State is always written in words; color supports meaning but never carries it.
Failures remain inspectable as quiet, ruled records beside their owning workflow without interrupting raw fail-open.

rules.name: The Blue Thread Rule
rules.body: Blue appears only where the interface needs to show selection, action, focus, or live state. Large inactive regions remain neutral.

rules.name: The Written State Rule
rules.body: Waiting, stale, failed, disabled, installed, and selected states must have adjacent text. Never ask hue alone to explain state.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif identifies the brand, titles the working sheet, and carries authored or generated prose. Sans-serif operates the product.

rules.name: The Compact Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracking is reserved for short labels; never apply it to paragraphs, long actions, or wrapped navigation text.

rules.name: The Linear Proof Rule
rules.body: Original → transformation context → Cleaned → Outgoing must read in that order without crossing the page or opening a manager.

rules.name: The Sheet, Not Card Rule
rules.body: Borders organize working surfaces; shadows only separate a complete sheet from the page. Do not turn every group into a card.

rules.name: The Earned Curve Rule
rules.body: A curve must identify a switch, a compact state, or a circular action. Content containers remain sheet-like.

rules.name: The Inspectable Failure Rule
rules.body: Every API failure leaves a durable, safe, copyable explanation at its owning workflow while the user's available path continues independently.

dos: Do inherit the incumbent paper, rail, rule, type, and control language on Workspace, Cleanup, and Targets.
Do preserve generous text canvases and compact setup controls.
Do keep prompt and vocabulary context visible with Cleaned.
Do keep Original, Cleaned, and Outgoing source unambiguous in every state.
Do use one continuous sheet or ruled list before adding another container.
Do preserve keyboard focus, resizing, text selection, and readable wrapping.
Do keep each simultaneous API failure separately named, persistent, and expandable at the workflow that owns it.
Do make visible safe details and copied details the same bounded dataset.
donts: Don't introduce rounded dashboard cards, bento grids, glass, or a second accent identity.
Don't use serif type for buttons, form labels, navigation, or status text.
Don't decorate inactive regions with blue or rely on color-only state.
Don't place Original and Cleaned side by side or hide the resizable divider.
Don't add recording-review UI, a target picker, or delivery claims to the workspace visual world.
Don't persist or depict real dictated content in documentation or comps.
Don't use a toast as the only failure record or collapse unrelated errors into one global banner.
Don't let an expanded error disclosure block editing, choosing Original, or understanding the current outgoing value.
